title: Timeline – NEWater Milestones
lineage: Selected passages paraphrased from the cited text.

passages.note: The prototype at Bedok opened in May 2000; Bedok and Kranji NEWater factories formally opened in January 2003. Changi 1 formally opened in May 2010 and Changi 2 in January 2017. The formal opening dates do not necessarily date first production.
